sections.Profile:
"Yanks" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Manufacturing Company on April 24, 1948. Designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin, the game features four flippers, ten passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Baseball, Sports
